To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
WlaRG, the first protein of the 81116 C. jejun LOS locus, catalyses aminotransference of a glucosamine moiety to the core oligosaccharide backbone.
WlaRG, aminotransaminase, is required for LOS synthesis and motility.

WlaRG, a putative aminotranserase, is required for the addition of a 4,5-di-O-phosphorylated N-acetylglucosamine to the LOS core, WlaTB, a putative glycosyltransferase, adds an N-acetylmannosamine to the core and WlaTC, a putative acetyltransferase, adds acetyl groups to the core.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the genetic and phenotypic characterization of the 81116 WlaRG, wlatB and wlaTC genes.
the role of WlaTB, WlaRG and WlaTC during C. jejui LOS synthesis.
LOS synthesis by C. jejunistrain 81116 and has provided new insights into the role of WlaRB, WlaTB, WlaTC, and the 81116 core LOS backbone.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
WlaRG, and WlaTC are involved in LOS core synthesis and WlaTB is involved in LOS core and O-antigen synthesis.
wlaRG, WLA TB, and WLA TC are involved in the biosynthesis of LOS in C. jejunii 81116.
WlaRG, w laTB and wla TC are involved in the biosynthesis of LOS by C. jejui 81116.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WlaRG, a putative aminotransfearse, is essential for the synthesis of the LOS backbone and that WlaTB and TC are involved in the addition of terminal sugars to the LOS core backbone.
wlaRG, WlATB and WlaTC are required for the synthesis of the LOS backbone in C. jejunistrain 81116.
the wlaTC mutant produced truncated LOS, the wlaTB mutant produced a truncated LOS with an altered core structure, and the wlaRG mutant produced a truncated and altered core LOS.
The main takeaway from our work is that
WlaRG, a novel aminotransaminase, WlaTB, a glycosyltransferase and WlaTC, a putative aminotransaminate synthetase, are all required for the synthesis of the LOS core backbone.
the LOS backbone is important for the immunogenicity of LOS, motility and adherence of C.  jejuni 81116.
wlaRG and the wlaTB/wlaTC genes are required for LOS synthesis and that the 81116 core is a tetrasaccharide.
